matchesTitle: Ingredients we have an answer for
matchesNote: Only these ingredients are in our list. The others aren't, and that doesn't mean they're harmless.
noMatchesTitle: None of its ingredients are in our list
noMatchesBody: That doesn't mean this product is harmless for your {species, select, cat {cat} other {dog}}. If they ate a lot of it, or seem unwell, call your vet.
noIngredientsTitle: No ingredient list for this product
noIngredientsBody: Open Food Facts knows this product but has no ingredient list for it. Type what it is, or its main ingredients, instead.
notFoundBody: It isn't in Open Food Facts yet. Type what it is, or its main ingredients, instead.
unavailableTitle: Can't look up barcodes right now
unavailableBody: Looking up a barcode needs a connection. Typed lookups work offline and give the same answers.
